articleTitle: Multi-features Based Arrhythmia Diagnosis Algorithm Using Xgboost
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Arrhythmia is the common disease in today's society. In order to judge the specific situation of the patient, doctors often observe the ECG (Electrocardiograph) signal to get enough information to help them diagnose. Many researches have been devoted to using various machine learning algorithms to study the classification problem of arrhythmia. However, single judgement cannot achieve acceptable results. Obviously, electrocardiogram signal data set has many missing data for various reasons. Fortunately, Xgboost has a strong ability to handle these problems. In this paper, the Multi-features Arrhythmia Diagnosis Algorithm Xgboost (MADA-Xgboost) is used in classification of arrhythmia. The data in the dataset is firstly divided into discrete data and continuous data. Cluster analysis algorithm is used to discretize continuous data. After that, integrate the processed data with the original discrete data. Then use principal components analysis (PCA) to make feature judgments and select the appropriate features. The next step is generating features vector through the chosen features. If the vector is generated, it can be used in Xgboost to adjust parameters and train the model. The modified parameters are number of iterations, depth, learning rate, alpha and gamma. Finally, after getting the trained model, using it to process the test data and classify the data as normal or abnormal. In order to prove the effectiveness of MADA-Xgboost, we analyze the data and algorithm. Obviously, people of different ages, genders, heights and weights have different health status. These data will affect the diagnosis of heart disease. At the same time, systolic blood pressure and diastolic blood pressure are also associated with the human health. In addition, Xgboost is not only highly accurate but also fast in classification. In this case, the MADA-Xgboost used in the paper is reasonable and correct.

articleTitle: Model-Based or Model-Free, a Review of Approaches in Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms can successfully solve a wide range of problems that we faced. Because of the Alpha Go against KeJie in 2017, the topic of RL has reached the completed new level of public opinion. Usually, reinforcement learning includes two categories, model-based method and model-free method, each of which shows unique advantages. Model-free RL can successfully solve various tasks, which can play video games and solve robotic tasks, but requires many samples to realize good performance. Model-based RL can quickly obtain near-optimal control by learning the model in a rather limited class of dynamics. In this situation, knowledge about the environment can be acquired in an unsupervised setting, even in trajectories where no rewards are available. However, its disadvantages lie in that most modelbased algorithms learn local models over-fitting several samples by depending on simple functional approximators, usually one mini-batch. The main body of this paper is going to summarize the classic algorithms in RL. Also, in the discussion part, new approaches are discussed, to keep the strength in model-based and model-free algorithms.

articleTitle: Phishing Website Detection Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Phishing websites are a means to deceive users' personal information by using various means to impersonate the URL address and page content of a real website. This paper analyzes the structural features of the URL of the phishing website, extracts 12 kinds of features, and uses four machine learning algorithms for training. Then, use the best performing algorithm as our model to identify unknown URLs. After the recognition is completed, a snapshot of the web page is extracted and compared with the regular web page snapshot to implement the recommendation of the original regular web page of the phishing web page.

articleTitle: The Application of Machine Learning Algorithms in Credit Card Default Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of the credit cards industry, there is an increasing number of delinquency rates on credit card loans, which imposes a financial risk for commercial banks. Therefore, successful resolutions of the risks are important for the healthy development of the industry in the long term. The existed methods, such as FICO model [1] (developed by Fair Isaac Company) can estimate the probabilities of credit card defaults, but it based totally on the subjective judgement of people. This means that FICO model comes with several undesirable problems, including low efficiency, low accuracy, time-consuming and high labor costs. In addition, the data of credit card defaults is always unbalanced, since few clients default in real world, which brings challenges to default model construction. In current big-data era, machine learning methods [2] are popular for its high efficiency and high accuracy. In this paper, we employed several classical machine learning algorithms, including logistic regression [3],decision tree [4] and ensemble learning [5] (adaboosting [6], random forest [7]), to build credit default prediction models. To solve the problem of unbalanced data [8], we further build corresponding weighted models so that it can improve the prediction accuracy of default class with slightly higher prediction error of non-default class. The results show that random forest models with weight is the best, which has achieved an accuracy of 82.12%. It achieves the goal of fast learning speed, high parallelism efficiency and high-volume data. Overall, machine learning algorithms has practical application value which can evaluate the delinquency precisely.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation and Practical Use of Supervised Data Mining Algorithms for Credit Card Approval
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Business analysis is using large volume of data to help people to make decision. Supervised learning methods are widely used in bank system, especially in credit card approval. The goal is to use various data mining algorithms to predict whether a new customer credit scores or to detect credit fraud. This will serve as the basis for the design of a new campaign because a transition from manual review to automatic review by computer could dramatically improve the work efficiency and reduce the labor costs. More tools such as self organizing map and algorithms could shed light on the self-evaluation for credit card applicants, which could raise efficiency.

articleTitle: Irony Detection Using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the ever-expanding social net, the use cases of irony detection and classification is also exponentially increasing. With this work, we take Task3 of SemEva1-2018 as our problem statement which further has two tasks. We intend to first determine if a given tweet is ironic or not (Task A) and then classify the tweets into four classes viz. non-ironic, verbal irony with contrast, verbal irony without contrast and situational irony (Task B). Existing papers have mainly exploited the lexical features of tweets using supervised machine learning. Here, we have proposed two NLP Transformer models viz. BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) and XLNets to classify tweets and have also compared our results to that of past papers. Using BERT, we have achieved F1 scores of 0.70 and 0.75 and using XLNets 0.74 and 0.59 for Task A and Task B respectively.

articleTitle: Recognition of Handwritten Digit Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In recent decades, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) has achieved remarkable results in both the research field and the application field due to the significant achievement acquired in computer technology. However, handwritten digit recognition still has great development space due to its complexity. At present, the recognition of handwriting has received intensive attention from many researchers. In this paper, we introduce the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based on TensorFlow framework is introduced, and use the MINIST data set which is widely used in handwritten digit recognition to analyze the structure and parameters of the CNN model. Furthermore, we utilize different functions and structures and analyze the problems in experiments, so as to provide some reference for the research and development aiming at handwritten digit recognition.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed Network Clock-Synchronization for Swarm UAV
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Clock-synchronization is the important technical support for data transmission and the coordinated control of swarm UAV ad hoc network. In this paper, the swarm UAV is designed after analyzing and comparing GPS, master-slave, and interactive clock synchronization. The distributed network clock-synchronization scheme is adopted, and Qualnet simulation is used to verify the convergence speed, network overhead, and adaptability to the network scale of this scheme. Compared with the existing algorithms, it has certain advantages.

articleTitle: Age Estimation from Face Images Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Age estimation via face images is widely used in different fields, including intelligent security, financial transactions, and public transportation. Even after many years' research, evaluating the specific age from facial images is still a challenging problem. Recently, deep learning-based methods are playing an important role in image processing, which provides a possible way to improve estimation models. We estimate accurate age and age range by testing several deep learning models, which include InceptionResNetV2, Xception, DenseNet121, ResNet152V2, VGG16, and InceptionV3. By comparing their performance, we discover that Xception has the highest accuracy of age estimation. To optimize the performance of these convolutional neural network, we apply the soft labelling technique and analyze the experiment results.

articleTitle: A TCM Question and Answer System Based on Medical Records Knowledge Graph
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In recent years, the combination of knowledge map and question and answer system are more and more applied in professional fields. In this paper, we firstly constructed a knowledge graph of traditional Chinese medical records which contains four entities: herbs, prescriptions, diseases, symptoms and their relationships; Secondly, we use Node2vec algorithm to represent the graph; Finally, we match questions and answers based on KNN. Experiment result shows that with the output of five prescriptions, our system's accuracy reaches 93.4%, which achieves good results.

articleTitle: Random Forest Based Scheduling Rules Mining in 3D Printing Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In a cloud manufacturing environment, decentralized physical resources form a manufacturing service network through interconnection and sharing. As a typical digital device in the current environment, 3D printing plays an important role in the construction of the network. To this end, this paper builds a print resource scheduling model under the network environment. Aiming at the problem of large randomness and discreteness in the generation of orders in the manufacturing network, this paper proposes a random forest based scheduling rule mining algorithm, which is combined with LR (Logistic Regression), CTRA (Decision Tree), KNN (k-Nearest Neighbor), SVM (support vector machines), SVM-CV (Cross validation support vector machines) and other algorithms are compared. The results show that RF has better performance in optimizing the solution results and running speed.

articleTitle: Welding Seam Recognition Robots Based on Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In order to meet the requirements of the accuracy and real-time performance during the working process of underwater welding robots, a scheme of welding seam recognition robots system based on the edge computing is proposed in this paper. A number of pre-processing methods for capturing welding seam image were designed, including Thresholding, Filtering and Edge Detect. A Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) model for welding seam recognition was also created. In the experiments, the image pre-processing and CNN algorithms were integrated in and deployed to the robots, and the learning and training algorithms of the CNN were deployed to the cloud servers. The image pre-processing methods filtered the interference in underwater operations and achieved the image compression and feature extraction. The cloud servers fulfilled the training and parameter optimization of the CNN, which improved the accuracy of welding seam image recognition.

articleTitle: The Analysis and Predication of Energy Use in Smart Homes Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: The development of Internet of Things and machine learning technology makes the realization of smart homes possible. It is conducive to saving energy and making people's lives more convenient. Data about the Internet of Things from Kaggle were used to analyze and predict energy use in smart homes, which includes various parameter values in the home environment. We predictd the users' power consumption to guide them to save electricity with the help of the machine learning model. This study proposes a scheme for forecasting household electricity consumption, which is further applicable to electricity consumption prediction of smart home systems with WIFI networking, regional and urban power grids. This achievement provides an idea for the application of smart home in the future.

articleTitle: Feature Selection Method Based on Hybrid SA-GA and Random Forests
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: We propose a feature selection algorithm based on hybrid simulated annealing (SA) - genetic algorithm (GA) and random forests, whose procedure can be described as the following steps. First, set an initial temperature and create an initial solution as current solution by binary encoding of the features. Then, generate a new potential solution according to the principle of crossover and mutation in the genetic algorithm. Next, construct random forests and calculate the fitness degree of the new potential solution by using out-of-bag (OOB) error. The acceptance of new state is based on Metropolis criterion, and the steps are iterated until a predefined lowest temperature is reached. Finally, a contrast experiment has done to show that the hybrid algorithm we proposed has better classification and feature selection performance than the methods from the existing literature.

articleTitle: Brief Review of Recent Researches in Speech Enhancement from Filters to Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: According to the World Health Organization, more and more people will suffer from hearing loss in the future. Therefore, there will be greater demand for the output and technology of hearing aids. Under the help of artificial intelligence, the technology of smart hearing aids will also become more intelligent, so that the wearer can get a better experience. This paper mainly studies the related problems of speech signal processing in intelligent digital hearing aids. This article focuses on the speech enhancement in digital hearing aids. First, this work studies the application of filter in speech enhancement technology, mainly introduces the Wiener filter algorithm using the minimum mean square error criterion; the Kalman filter algorithm that can solve discrete signals; spectral subtraction based on multi-window spectrum estimation. Secondly, this paper studies some specific methods of deep learning technology in speech enhancement, mainly introduces DNN-based speech enhancement method, deep learning-based auditory cepstrum coefficient speech enhancement algorithm, and AE-CGAN-based speech enhancement algorithm. Finally, this paper studies the related problems of acoustic scene classification, divides the listening environment into Gaussian white noise, impact noise, and music noise, and explains the solutions for each listening environment.

articleTitle: From Statistics to Data Mining: A Brief Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the popularity of the Internet and the development of information technology, hundreds of millions of information and data that are so close to our human kind are recorded. In recent decades, as an interdisciplinary, data science has had a vigorous development. This paper mainly discusses two core problems in data science, that are data analysis and data mining. Beginning with the data analysis based on statistics, this paper discusses and reviews data mining based on traditional machine learning and that based on neural network. Then it discusses the common problems in data mining. Each part summarizes the corresponding application and research. Through the discussion of the basic contents in data analysis and data mining, this paper provides a powerful help for the future research in this field.

articleTitle: Scene Text Detection Using Context-Aware Pyramid Feature Extraction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In the past decades, scene text detection has been attached much attention. Many researchers carried out researches on deep learning or neural network. However, the common scene text detection methods are sometimes inadequate because of the various forms and complex characteristics in natural scene images. To overcome those deficiencies, we propose an algorithm combing the Efficient and Accurate Scene Text Detector Model (EAST) with the Context-aware Pyramid Feature Extraction module (CPFE). Built on the base of fully convolutional neural network (FCN), CPFE is integrated to expend receptive field and obtain multi-scale and high-level features from context, which largely overcome the deficiency in scene text detection. Experiments conducted on the ICDAR2015 dataset show that our model outperforms the original EAST model.

articleTitle: A Review on Machine Learning and Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This is a review on Machine Learning and Gesture Recognition based on researches on Machine Learning and Gesture Recognition. It also includes my personal interpretation and ideas for the future. By conducted an indepth study on the gesture recognition technology based on machine learning, researched on accurate segmentation algorithm of multi-gesture images based on skin color, analyzed the distribution characteristics of skin color in different color spaces under different brightness, by combining gestures in actual scenes Segmentation quality to find the best color space for building skin model, researchers also developed and implemented a gesture recognition control system for home scenes: elaborating the hardware and software environment of the gesture recognition control system and explaining the gesture collection system and gesture recognition function. The system was tested in terms of function, performance, and the technical advantages to make sure the overall advantages of the system.

articleTitle: Diagnosis of Breast Cancer Based on Support Vector Machine and Random Forest Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: A surge of breast cancer in health issues has set new challenges to clinical routine. With the help of data and image processing, artificial intelligence is possible to assist or automate doctors in diagnosis. On the basis of Wisconsin Breast Cancer Diagnosis (WDBC) database, this paper concentrated on Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier and Random Forest (RF) to evaluate the features extracted from the tumor nucleus. Then the conclusion was made that SVM classifier has better prediction effect, with 97% AUC and accuracy. And the worst of the perimeter and concave points are two most important features among all the 30 characters. Hence only a model with 2 features can realize the idea results when the efficiency rate is high and data collection is simple. The outcomes showed that the promising factors to be applied to clinical diagnosis so as to suggest possible results, help laymen interpret pathological examination results, enhance the work efficiency of medical staff and mitigate their pressure.

articleTitle: Kidney Disease Diagnosis Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Many patients around the world lose their lives due to chronic diseases, but they are difficult to be diagnosed in a short time. We used data samples from Indian patients with kidney disease to investigate chronic disease. Correlation between each kidney disease index and the patient's condition showed the importance of personal physical information. Then we compared the prediction results by using Logistic Regression model and BP neural network model on these data set to diagnose the incidence of kidney disease. After testing, we found that the prediction accuracy, recall, and F1 score obtained by the Logistic Regression algorithm are less than the performance of these indicators obtained by the BP neural network on the prediction performance. It can be seen that the BP neural network can be more effective in making a diagnosis of kidney disease. Identification of kidney diseases can be more efficient with artificial intelligence through this method of machine learning, which has promoted the development of medical and health fields.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Hand Gesture Dataset
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Currently, a bunch of research is going in the field of human computer interaction, such as hand gesture recognition, estimation, and hand tracking, one of the important and popular research directions. However existing hand gesture datasets have their limitation such as shortage of number of data, lack of various background and enough volunteers. In order to deal with these problems, this paper proposes a novel and comprehensive dataset of hand gesture. This dataset consists of two parts, Dataset1 and Dataset2. Both datasets include various backgrounds and abundant involved persons. In this paper, a detailed comparison of existing popular datasets is listed. Dataset1, has ten thousand images in total for images classification and Dataset2 contains seven thousand in total for hand tracking. Details about how to build these datasets are represented. Both of datasets are shared online for usage in imaged-based hand gesture recognition research.

articleTitle: Study on the Evaluation of Practical Teaching Quality in Applied Undergraduate Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In order to improve the teaching quality of applied undergraduate colleges, the construction and optimization of practical teaching quality evaluation system is particularly important. In this paper, DEA model is used to build the practical teaching evaluation index of applied undergraduate colleges, analyze the input and output, and compare the comprehensive efficiency, pure technical efficiency and scale efficiency. In addition, this paper provides effective improvement methods for non DEA decision-making units from establishing evaluation indexes, optimizing teaching staff, realizing resource sharing and innovating management mode, so as to achieve DEA effectivity.

articleTitle: Research on Strategy of HS300 Index Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the development of China's economy and the continuous improvement of the stock market, stock investment has gradually become one of the ways for people in financial management. It also attracts non-mathematicians to participate in the prediction of stock prices. Models such as machine learning in artificial intelligence are beginning to be widely used in stock forecasting to predict stock trends. This paper calculated the 11 technical indicators of the HS300 index, and used the Random Forest model to predict the movements. The results showed that the accuracy of the model calculation to 0.82 and the F-score is 0.84. Then, the daily income of the model was integrated. Then annualized return reached 28.1%, and the maximum drawdown was 0.42, which was significantly higher than the index return. The results showed that the Random Forest model adopted in this paper is feasible. With the introduction of more and more machine learning methods, artificial intelligence will be further developed in the field of quantitative investment.

articleTitle: UAV Automatic Docking Technology Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Deep learning was widely used in various fields in recent times. The effect it has shown in some areas even surpassed experts in the field. In this paper, we used deep learning technology and applied it to the drone automatic docking technology. The realization of this technology is conducive to people's intelligent and efficient daily life in the future. The parking lots of the data set we used was taken in the Northern Arizona University, Flagstaff, USA. For some images in the data set, we also used data enhancement methods to improve our training efficiency. The final result of our experiment fully proved the correctness and effectiveness of our method. The recognition rate of the parking lot is as high as 96.7% including different weather, lighting conditions, and more, on this basis, the accuracy of the automatic docking technology of the drone that it introduces is 63.2%. And behind this, we sealed the technology of the automatic recognition of parking spaces in the drone into an application.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based People Detection, Tracking and Re-identification in Intelligent Video Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Intelligent video surveillance has gained increasing needs and attentions due to its greatly potential in security and social governance. In this paper, we integrate three parts of video surveillance system together, including people detection, tracking and person re-identification to construct a systematic research framework. Following a brief introduction, we first present current problems and difficulties of people detection, tracking and re-identification. Then the state-of-the-art deep learning based algorithms in recent years are summarized and evaluated. At last we put forward the prospect of current research directions, providing a relatively comprehensive knowledge base for the future development of intelligent surveillance video systems.

articleTitle: Future Challenges in the Next Generation of Voice User Interface
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence technology, artificial interactions come up for providing powerful assistance to our lives. Among them, voice user interface (VUI) plays important roles in assisting the disabled and complex interaction scenarios. This paper mainly introduces the key elements and core technics in VUI. Also, future challenges will be discussed from the perspective of empathy, ethics, and accessibility. This paper serves as a summary for future study in VUI.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Meets Astronomy
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Astronomy meets a great development during recent period. With the help of novel instrument, the astronomers meet with a large volume of the data sets. However, it also brings a lot of challenges to them. On the other side, there is also an innovation of the machine learning starts from the 21st century. The robustness of the computer provides a powerful tool for analyzing such large volume of data. Therefore, in this paper, three different algorithms (support vector machine, principal component analyze and neural network) and their application are introduced in this paper. The high accuracy achieved from this application indicated that such algorithms can be applied for the data sets and some further researches are suggested for better development of astronomy knowledge.

articleTitle: Rumor Detection of Sina Weibo Based on MCF Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Sina Weibo as the most popular social network application in China has become an important social media and also a perfect platform for rumor spreading. According to current investigate and research, there are at least 516 million active users every month till the end of 2019, and this number doubled in 2020 as a result of CODIV-19. Weibo becomes the main news resource for most people during their quarantine. People during quarantine have a lot of spare time to keep reading that constant refreshing news and they will believe those News comes from Weibo without thinking because there are lots of information, which people hard to prove all those authenticities. Rumor detection always a big challenge for researchers to study and for the government to control. There are lots of related works about detecting rumors based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms. However, most of them overlooked the importance of blog comments. Comments of one micro blog is really an important source for identifying rumors, and also there are seldom researches related to comments exist. This paper using commenter's credit as weight, which added on comment context's emotion analysis result, combined with Weibo users profile features as input of a pretrained Support Vector Machine (SVM) module. In this way to make the rumor detection result more accurate and precise. Also, the diversity of commenters background and richness of comment contexts makes the analysis result more accurate than only analyze Weibo content.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Classifiers Based on Stock Prediction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Nowadays, machine learning methods are widely used for prediction. In this paper, stock prediction performance of classifiers is evaluated. It can be concluded that the accuracy of classification is influenced by the selected algorithms as well as other factors (e.g. the input form). Besides, the appreciation of assets cannot be neglected, and using multiple categories to describe the movement of stock markets may be helpful.

articleTitle: A Review on Action Recognition and Its Development Direction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Human action recognition has gradually developed into a popular research field. This article starts from the steps of action recognition and the methods commonly used in each step. It divides it into two parts: motion tracking and analysis, and definition of motion. In the first step, three commonly used methods based on bone joint points, based on optical flow and based on points of time and space are introduced, and their advantages and disadvantages are further elaborated. The commonly used method in the second step is based on neural networks and graph models. In this paper, CNN, RNN, LSTM and other mainstream algorithms are used to introduce neural networks. Hidden Markov models and restricted Boltzmann machines introduce graph models. Finally, the development direction of behavior recognition is discussed, and multi-person interactive behavior recognition and behavior recognition in other fields, such as vehicle behavior recognition, are proposed.

articleTitle: A Review on the Extraction of Region of Interest in Traffic Sign Recognition System
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This paper analyzes the main issues of extraction of region of interest (ROI) in TSD (Traffic Sign Detection) system which include illumination inconsistency, distortion and computing efficiency. The reason why these issues occur and how they affect the performance of the system are discussed. Among all the issues, illumination inconsistency has a major influence and is often prioritized when it comes to the design of TSD system. Different methods have been brought up to deal with the issue. Some choose to improve the conventional methods to achieve better results, while others choose to utilize new tools, like CNN, to form new designs. All these methods are presented in details and compared in performance to present a overlook on the current status of TSD system.

articleTitle: Wireless Communication Using Electromagnetic Wave with Orbital Angular Momentum
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of wireless communication, the channel transmission is close to the Shannon-Hartley theorem, so the birth of new technologies is urgently needed. At the same time, the discovery and development of orbital angular momentum (OAM) provides new ideas for wireless communications. Due to the mutual orthogonality of OAM wave modes, spatial multiplexing becomes possible, beams of the same frequency with OAM can travel simultaneously, and the channel capacity efficiency can be greatly improved.

articleTitle: Part-Weighted Deep Representation Learning for Person Re-Identification
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Person Re-identification (ReID) is to identify the same person across different cameras. It is challenging due to various appearance presented by person images, especially when some person body parts are missing caused by detectors or occlusions. To overcome these challenges, in this paper we propose a Part-Weighted Deep (PWD) model. Our deep multi branch network jointly learns complementary discriminative features from aligned whole body image and body part regions, which are acquired by a pose estimation algorithm. To estimate the reliability of features extracted from local body parts, a Feature Fusion sub-Net (FFN) is designed to learn the weight of each body part, which is used to fuse representation in training stage and aggregate part similarity scores between two person images in testing stage. Extensive experiments demonstrate the significant performance improvements of our PWD model over the state-of-the-art methods on two benchmarks (Market-1501, Duke).

articleTitle: Implicit Bias or Explicit Bias: An Analysis Based on Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Text is a common form of language which is a source to mine people's bias. And bias always exists on some special concepts. However, psychology studies show that, on several specific concepts, the explicit bias is sometimes different from the implicit bias. Current method does not distinguish explicit and implicit bias although they do have certain imparities. Inspired by the two special tests from implicit and explicit bias, we developed an automatic language-based technique to reproduce the psychological tests. We build connection between sentences which is the combination of certain words and each psychological measurement and then engender explicit bias and implicit bias by understanding the emotional issue of statements.

articleTitle: Research on the Control Strategy of Robot Fish Game in Dynamic Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In order to improve the scoring efficiency and solve the problem that the robot fish was easy to lose the target, we designed the general strategy of robot fish game based on fuzzy control in this paper. According to the dynamic environment of the game, an evaluation function was constructed to select the target ball. And a path planning and dribbling method of the robot fish was put forward to avoid getting stuck in the game. The experimental results showed that the scoring efficiency of the robot fish was improved and it was not easy to lose the ball.

articleTitle: Active Object Searching Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Recently, computer vision has progressed a lot and object detection by robot has drawn interests of many researchers. By combining artificial intelligence and traditional industry together, computer vision and object detection has gained remarkable achievements. Though robot can detect the still complete images quite efficiently with a considerable accuracy, yet the active object detection and searching is a relatively new field. Since a robot is able to adjust its position to get a better view of the images, a good policy of the action selection should be payed attention to. In this paper, several DQN-like algorithms are introduced and compared. Then in a bid to weaken the estimation bias of them, a Maxmin DQN algorithm is implemented on a household dataset. After comparing the performance of these algorithms, the Maxmin DQN proves to be the best on average.

articleTitle: Design of Smart Home System Based on ARM and RFID
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This paper provides the systematical researches on smart home, from the perspective of the architecture design, communication system design, network design, network node design, communication circuit design, gateway circuit design, as well as the network data storage and relevant transmission, etc. According to the researches above, this paper conducts a prototype of a smart home system, using the ARM processor as the gateway, with the transmission of RFID and WIFI protocol.

articleTitle: Research and Prospect of Applications Based on the Internet of Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In the past few years, the technology of the Internet of Vehicles has rapidly developed. More and more new vehicles are connected to the Internet. However, the purpose and function of the application are not fully developed. This paper will introduce the concept and the key technology of the Internet of Vehicles and give two examples of the application based on the Internet of Vehicles to explain how it improves the traditional business and improve user experience. Finally, give the prospect of the applications based on the Internet of Vehicles.

articleTitle: The Model of COVID-19 Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: To Investigate the pandemic model of COVID-19 based on traditional SIR model and formulate an ideal Time Lagging-SEIR model of COVID-19, author starts from giving basic SEIR model, and gradually refines it with taking consider more unique factors which contained by COVID-19. After giving the refined COVID-19 model function, author states that there are several parameters cannot be derived currently, thus the model function needed to be simplified. Several necessary parameters are given by using data collected in WuHan and citing from research papers from others, and liner regression is used to find rate of death and recovery which are always changing during the whole spreading process. In the end of this paper, author gives a function group of COVID-19 model which have all necessary parameters given in the paper.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Input and Output Layers of a Deep Neural Network in Adversarial Defense
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Deep neural networks are learning models having achieved state of the art performance in many fields like prediction, computer vision, language processing and so on. However, it has been shown that certain inputs exist which would not trick a human normally, but may mislead the model completely. These inputs are known as adversarial inputs. These inputs pose a high security threat when such models are used in real world applications. In this work, we have analyzed the resistance of three different classes of fully connected dense networks against the rarely tested non-gradient based adversarial attacks. These classes are created by manipulating the input and output layers. We have proven empirically that owing to certain characteristics of the network, they provide a high robustness against these attacks, and can be used in fine tuning other models to increase defense against adversarial attacks.

articleTitle: IMM-EKF Based GPS/INS Combined Positioning Method for Drone
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Satellite navigation system is currently the most widely used positioning and navigation infrastructure. It can provide users with outdoor real-time, high-precision location information, but it is susceptible to environmental occlusion and carrier motion interference, making location availability poor. This paper addresses the needs of UAVs for high accuracy and high availability of position information, using inertial devices and satellite navigation systems for integrated navigation, and proposes a multi-model filtering method for tracking different motion models and filtering to improve the fusion positioning Accuracy and robustness, enabling high-precision, high-availability positioning in complex environments. And by simulating the uniform velocity motion (CV), uniform acceleration motion (CA) and uniform turning motion (CT) of the UAV, the positioning performance of the method is analyzed. From the simulation results, the method improves the integration of inertial navigation and GPS. Positioning accuracy and reliability.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in the Application of Deep Learning to Choreography
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Choreography is the arrangement and design of dance movements according to music. The application of computer technology to dance generation improves the efficiency and quality of choreography. This paper categorizes the methods used in dance generation over the last two decades. And the paper summarizes the latest research issues in this field, including creating new movements, matching the movement to the rhythm, conducting choreograph conservation, and finding the semantic connection between dance and music. The researchers' models and results for these issues are detailed in the paper. Finally, the future research direction is discussed.

articleTitle: A Design of Real-time Status Updated Charging Service APP
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Under the background that the country advocates green travel and vigorously promotes the development of new energy industry, electric vehicles are bound to be gradually popularized in China, and the demand of electric vehicle users for charging service is also increasing. In order to let electric vehicle users know the location and availability of the charging pile station nearby in real time, it is a feasible scheme to build an intelligent pile station management platform by applying the rapid development of cloud computing technology and mobile app based on map navigation function. However, with the increase of the number of charging piles and charging stations, it is bound to put forward higher requirements for the performance of the management platform. This paper proposes an optimization scheme based on LBS cloud retrieval technology to update the available status of a large number of piles.

articleTitle: A virtual environment making method for CAVE system
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: CAVE immersive system is a large VR system with high immersion and good interaction means. CAVE can integrate vision, touch, sound, etc., and is widely used in architecture display, equipment structure research, simulation training, scientific research and other fields with high requirements for space sense and visual effect. According to the structure and number of projection screens, the virtual environment in CAVE immersion system need to display multi screen images synchronously. But the existing multi screen display methods are too complex, and even require paid plugins. In order to solved this problem, a method of making CAVE immersive virtual environment based on unity 3D was proposed. This method was very simple and could create virtual reality applications suitable for various CAVE systems quickly.

articleTitle: Research on the Human-Computer Interaction Design in Mobile Phones
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Mobile phones play an important role in our modern life. Meanwhile, the development of human-computer interaction has promoted the progress of the mobile phone industry. A good human-computer interaction design model needs to consider the user's understanding of the product system, but also needs to use ergonomics and cognitive psychology to carry out in-depth analysis and research on the user. The emergence of mobile communications and cloud computing technologies has also changed people's lifestyles. Firstly, through the discussion and research on the relationship between human-computer interaction and ergonomics and cognitive psychology, some key points that human-computer interaction design can influence the development trend of mobile phones are proposed. This article will also point out the impact of communication technology and cloud computing technology on mobile phones and people's lifestyles. Besides, the different operating systems of mobile phones will be compared and analyzed. Due to the different human-computer interaction experience in different user groups, the different requirements of them on a mobile phone will be analyzed. At the same time, the article also pays attention to the social problems caused by people's over-reliance on mobile phones. Finally, this article will make a reasonable prediction of the future development trend of mobile phones.

articleTitle: The Research of RBPF-SLAM Accuracy under the Influence of Depth Camera Noises
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In order to study the influence of random noises of ToF depth camera on the pose estimation of mobile robot based on improved RBPF-SLAM algorithm, the basic principles and processes of improved RBPF-SLAM algorithm were described in this paper. Secondly, we analyzed and established the Gaussian model of random noises of ToF depth camera. Finally, through the computer simulation method, we used the ROS robot operating system to estimate the trajectory of mobile robot under depth camera noises. The RMS errors of mobile robot trajectory were calculated. The research method and simulation results in this paper can be referenced for the design of mobile robot SLAM system.

articleTitle: Stock Picking Strategy Based on Exploration of Chip Distribution Indicators
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Factor investment can be considered as a quantitative approach which can explain the return on stocks, there are hundreds of factors that are found and proved to be effective to variation of stock price over the past fifty years. Since CAPM [1], Fama-French three factors model [2] had been raised, multi-factor models are gradually developed and exploration of factors have never been disrupted. Cost of carry is believed to be a factor which could affect the psychology and investing decision of the investors. From this point of view some CYQ factors based on cost of carry could be excavated with attempt of explaining the relationship between these factors and the returns. Firstly, we established four factors (ARC, KRC, SRC, VRC) related to cost of carry based on the stock trading data of A-shares. Two approaches that had been used to verify the effectiveness of the factors includes returns of purely factors and returns of long and short related group of stocks. Finally, serval indicators like total annualized returns, volatility and Sharpe ratio etc. are calculated to evaluate the performance of factors and ARC factor was found to be the most effective for stock picking since year 2016, of which annualized return is 0.07 in HS300, 0.11 in SZ50 and 0.08 in ZZ500, Sharpe ratio is 1.07 in HS300, 1.43 in SZ50 and 1.41 in ZZ500.

articleTitle: Detecting Neuronal Assemblies in Spontaneous Activity with Dictionary Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Ever since the pioneering work of Donald Hebb, neuronal assembly has been receiving extensive attention from neuroscientists. Different methods including PCA and ICA have been proposed to detect neuronal assemblies. In this paper, we apply a new method, i.e., dictionary learning with size optimization to calcium imaging data in order to solve this problem. The method used here can be generalized to datasets obtained with different methods and with various sizes.

articleTitle: The Trend of lmage Segmentation 3 Research: An Overview Based on Traditional, Supervised and Semi-supervised Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Deep convolutional networks are powerful visual models in image segmentation. Traditional methods like Edge Detection and Grab-cut have a large amount of computation and slow processing speed. However, our research into the existing body of literature reveals that supervised learning and semi-supervised learning increasingly become the mainstream algorithms. In order to predict the trend of the image segmentation algorithm, we firstly review the traditional semantic segmentation methods and DeepLab methods. Then summarize the semi-supervised network methods and discuss their advantages and disadvantages. At the end of the paper, we compare DeepLab method with semi-supervised method, and our analysis find that the performance of semi-supervised networks is good, but it still needs some improvement when dealing with a large amount of datasets. Thus, we highlight the value of semi-supervised networks by combining with DeepLab for higher prediction accuracy. It is also a novel direction for image segmentation algorithms.

articleTitle: Predictive Modeling of U.S. Housing Prices Reveals Key Indicators of Real Estate Prices and Economic Health
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Housing market is one of the key sectors of the economy. Understanding and forecasting changes in the housing market is therefore essential for an economic analysis. This work analyzes trends in housing prices and related variables using predictive linear and random forest models. Key variables related housing prices are identified and successfully used to predict housing prices for out of sample forecast. The models presented in this study are valuable tools to evaluate housing market trends, and they can be easily extended over time because of their ease and efficiency of use.

articleTitle: The Challenges and Methods of Natural Scene Text Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: The detection and recognition of text in natural scenes are basis to computer vision application field. Text detection is designed to localize text areas in natural scenes for further usages. This article first elaborates on the challenges of scene text detection from the perspective of the characteristics of natural scene text. Secondly, the current common methods of scene text detection are introduced. Furthermore, the application of scene text detection is discussed. Finally, its research and development trend are prospected.

articleTitle: A Novel Multi-Attribute Face-to-Cartoon Model for Human-Computer Interaction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Human-computer interaction in social media have attracted increasing attentions from both academic and industry. To explore a new engaging and interesting form of human-computer interaction, this paper introduces a novel multi-attribute face-to-cartoon system for social media. This system can generate a corresponding emoji from a face snapshot. The system first captures the target face of the selected snapshot and then utilizes a convolutional network to predict its attribute, such as emotion, gender, and glasses. By using this attribute information, this system aims at finding a corresponding emoji. Furthermore, a demo application based on Ubuntul6.04 is also introduced. The experimental results with this demo application verify the performance of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Convolutional Neural Networks for Multimode Fiber Study: A Review
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Multimode fiber is the one of the hottest research area in telecom and nonlinear optics. However, under most circumstances, the output of a multimode fiber is a speckle pattern which cannot be easily demodulated. To solve the problem and make multimode fibers practical, machine learning can be combined with multimode fibers. The deep neural network, when given enough input and the corresponding output data, can learn and inverse the transmission matrix of a fiber. In this way, the fiber's complex properties can be studied automatically. In this paper, I will review several studies done by scientists on the topic and try to analyze and summarize them.

articleTitle: Calculation of Frame Internal Force Based on MATLAB Matrix Displacement Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This paper describes how to design the program of continuous beam and rigid frame based on MATLAB and the matrix displacement method. The paper also points out the demonstration of matrix displacement method and the principle of MATLAB programming. As well as to realize the correspondence between manual calculation and computer calculation, some techniques are included, such as "multiplicative number method" and visual design, which will be shown in this paper. Therefore, this paper will be based on the structural mechanics textbooks, using MATLAB as a programming tool, combined with the principle of matrix displacement method, to achieve the whole process from inputting information to outputting the moment diagram.

articleTitle: An Improved Surf Algorithm Image Feature Point Extraction Based on Hadoop Cluster
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This paper discusses the method of extracting image feature points on a Hadoop cluster using an improved Surf algorithm. Edge detection is performed on the pictures with Prewitt operator. The feature points are extracted at the edge of the target image by Surf algorithm, which remarkably decreases the amount offeature points in the image. The parallel processing of images on Hadoop cluster platform greatly improve the processing speed of massive images.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Three Numeric Algorithms for Lasso Solution
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the rapid development of information science and statistics, significant improvement in the ability to handle huge-sized data has been seen, including linear regression. However, traditional statistical methods remain as a problem when the number of samples is less than the rapidly increasing data dimensions and constructing a mathematical model in high-dimensional scenario may work it out. Hopefully linear regression becomes kind of solvable problem as far as singular matrix is transformed into nonsingular matrix through introduction of L2 norm as penalty term. Nevertheless, this method has to be ungraded by a new method titled `Lasso' when options of variables is inaccessible to it. Coordinate descent method, alternating direction method of multipliers and proximal gradient descent method are gateways to Lasso, among others. The coordinate descent method gets the minimum value of each component on basis of L1 penalty term. Alternating direction method of multipliers the minimum value by processing decomposed objective functions separately. The proximal gradient descent method is a method of Taylor expansion at a point where initial value is selected. This paper has showed the results of simulation experiments on the three algorithms in terms of accuracy and convergence speed. It reveals that alternating direction method of multipliers, superior to the rest two both by speed and accuracy, is followed by The proximal gradient descent method, while The coordinate descent method is not equal.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Gasoline Octane Number Based on Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: The octane number of the gasoline is related to its antiknock performance. A stable octane number can efficiently use the gasoline, without affecting the performance of automobile. In order to make the use of gasoline in internal combustion engine safer and more efficient, this paper studies the prediction of gasoline octane number. In this experiment, the Back-propagation (BP) network of ANN is used for prediction. The data processing method and network structure are introduced in the paper. The experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of octane number increases gradually under the condition of increasing the test data set, reducing the maximum convergence time and increasing the learning rate.

articleTitle: Improving Agile Development from Perspective of Design-Informing Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Agile development is usually used to solve the problem of inflexibility which the other project management models, like the Waterfall model and the V model, may meet. However, conventional agile development still faces many problems under rapid iterations. Frequent iteration lacks efficient communication a large community, resources to share information, and quality of product. For better project management, this article describes a method, called the design-informing model (DIM), to improve the agile development. The design-informing model consists of four parts, user mental mode, developer mental model, system model, and environmental model. At the end of the paper, some discussions will be conducted to evaluate DIM in practice.

articleTitle: A New Verifiable Image Encryption Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Existing image encryption algorithms have two problems: 1) once the key and plaintext are selected, the output encrypted images are determined, leading to security weakness; 2) existing methods have no verifiable function to verify the correct sender. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a new verifiable image encryption network. By using chaotic system and hash map, this encryption approach can be able to secure the data with additional verification phase to detect the sender. Experimental results are provided to demonstrate its verification performance and high security level.

articleTitle: Characterizing the Weight Space for Different Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Deep Learning has become one of the primary research areas in developing intelligent machines. Most of the well-known applications (such as Speech Recognition, Image Processing and NLP) of AI are driven by Deep Learning. Deep Learning algorithms mimic human brain using artificial neural networks and progressively learn to accurately solve a given problem. But there are significant challenges in Deep Learning systems. There have been many attempts to make deep learning models imitate the biological neural network. However, many deep learning models have performed poorly in the presence of adversarial examples. Poor performance in adversarial examples leads to adversarial attacks and in turn leads to safety and security in most of the applications. In this paper we make an attempt to characterize the solution space of a deep neural network in terms of three different subsets viz. weights belonging to exact trained patterns, weights belonging to generalized pattern set and weights belonging to adversarial pattern sets. We attempt to characterize the solution space with two seemingly different learning paradigms viz. the Deep Neural Networks and the Dense Associative Memory Model, which try to achieve learning via quite different mechanisms. We also show that adversarial attacks are generally less successful against Associative Memory Models than Deep Neural Networks.

articleTitle: Research on Track Irregularity Full Speed Segment Detection Based on Adaptive Fuzzy Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: In recent years, the construction of China's rail transportation has grown rapidly. Whether it is an I-shaped track or a grooved-shaped track, the detection of track irregularities is mostly based on the inertial reference method or the string measurement method, but both methods are limited by the speed factor to varying degrees. This paper studies a comprehensive detection method based on fuzzy neural network that combines the inertial reference method with the four-point chord method. It can realize high-precision detection of speed fuzzy speed section (transition speed section), so as to achieve detection of full speed section, and overcome system errors caused by algorithm factors.

articleTitle: CNN-Based Image Style Transfer and Its Applications
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Convolutional neural network is a variant of deep neural network. It is widely used to extract image features and used in image classification, image generation and style transfer. In the style transfer task, we can extract the content from one picture through the convolutional neural network, extract the style from another picture, and generate a new picture by the combination. In this paper, we show the general steps of image style transfer based on convolutional neural networks through a specific example, and discuss the future possible applications.

articleTitle: Research on Identifying Phlegm-Damp Constitution in Obese People Based on Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: As one of the main constitutions of obese patients, there is a considerable amount of data showing that phlegm-damp constitution is more likely to have serious adverse consequences. Although accurate identification of the patient's constitution is the key and prerequisite for the good results of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) to treat obesity, the TCM identification method is far from meeting the needs and expectations of modern society for high-quality medical practice. In this paper, combined with machine learning methods, the physical identification of phlegm-damp patients was targeted. We collected data from obese patients obtained from clinical observations in hospitals to establish a database, and used Correlation, Logistic Regression, Recursive Feature Elimination, and Random Forests to sort the feature importance of factors. Factors that strongly affect obese people are medical history, height, body mass index, fat and thinness index, gloss color, tongue color, fur color, etc. Then the above-mentioned features were selected to establish a phlegm-damp constitution identification model. The accuracy and F1 score of various models were compared. The results showed that L2 Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine, and LightGBM did well in classification of phlegm-damp constitution in obese people. This study provides a useful reference for research ideas and methods for the objective, precise, and intelligent realization of constitution identification.

articleTitle: Two-Stage Network-Based Inventory Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: The objective of this research is to develop an optimal two-stage network-based inventory system for a supply chain consisting of Regional Distribution Centers (RDC) and Front Distribution Centers (FDC). According to the size of numbers of periods, we divide the problem into small scale and large scale. In small-scale case, we try to utilize the linearization method to obtain the exact solution of problem. In large-scale case, we try to use meta-heuristic method to obtain the approximation solution. We provide a genetic algorithm solution and an illustrative example on the two-stage supply chain. Furthermore, we perform comprehensive sensitivity analysis of each input parameter to analyse their contribution to the model objective function value and response time.

articleTitle: Lightpath Simulation in Optical Systems Based on Matrix Optics Method
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Optical simulation often plays an essential role in the field of imaging. The visualization of lightpath and setup especially worth considering for it directly illustrates the property of the optical system. However, commercial optical simulation software is usually massive in volume, costs high, and requires training for operation. In this paper, a simulation method will be introduced for the visualization of the optical lightpath and the setup. In this work, an algorithm in Python/Matlab environment based on matrix optics, which is an efficient approach for describing both geometrical and wave optical lightpath as well. Conducted several simulations, the algorithm yields accurate results, demonstrating the practical usage of the method, while the friendly environment promising a further improvement of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Social Study Based Review on Image Aesthetic Assessment and Editing
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Previous research and review work on image aesthetic assessment mainly focused on technical developments and accomplishments, but none of them discussed the social influence. This paper not only reviews recent researches done in the field of image aesthetic assessment and editing, introduces typical image datasets, but also discusses the latent and potential moral and cultural dilemma that may be caused by these new techniques. It is believed that social study should be more emphasized in the future as the relevant techniques become more developed and mature.

articleTitle: Detect and Depornize Pornographic Images Using Pre-trained CNN Models
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: The ubiquitous Internet has achieved great transparency of information; however, it also becomes the media of negative information, especially pornographic content. Classifying and filtering out such content are of high demand on the social networks. CNN models can be used to classify pornographic images with good flexibility and high accuracy. However, building CNN models from scratch is complex and computationally expensive. Fortunately, training pre-trained CNN models using the technique of transfer learning takes relatively less time to develop and can still deliver great performances. In this paper, we show that the most recent pretrained CNN models can be re-trained to be pornographic image detectors using the technique of transfer learning. Furthermore, considering the practical applications in social media and entertainment, this paper introduces a depornize algorithm to cover these sensitive and pornographic content. Experimental results demonstrate the efficiency of both algorithms proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Prediction Intervals for Mechanical Property Forecasting with Improved ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Application of Adaptive-Network-based Fuzzy Inference System (ANFIS) for point forecast has burgeoned in recent years. While the performance of ANFIS drops when the uncertainty level increases in dataset, and point forecasts also suffer from unreliable and uninformative problems. Prediction interval (PI) has been proposed as a powerful tool to address these drawbacks. In spite of plentiful application of ANFIS for constructing PIs, the use in mechanical property forecasting is limited. Compared with traditional computational expensive algorithms, in this paper, we combine Particle Swarm optimization (PSO) and Genetic Algorithm (GA) to minimize the cost function and optimize the parameters of ANFIS. The proposed novel approach is applied to a real mechanical property forecasting case study. The outcomes show modified PSO-based ANFIS not only computational less expensive, but also with good quality of constructing better PIs.

articleTitle: An Analysis ofDriver Cognitive Distraction
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Driver distraction detection is a very important problem today. There are a large number of accidents occur every year. In this paper, we give some example of a variety of driver distraction detection methods and present an organized review. Our discussion focuses on the characteristics of driver distraction detection methods and the comparison of advantages and disadvantages, so that readers can quickly understand the mainstream methods in this field. We also propose some opinions on the field of distraction detection.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Deep Learning Models for Kannada Handwritten Digit Recognition
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Handwritten digit recognition is a basic and important problem in computer vision. While it has been studied intensively, the newer datasets keep bring new challenges to existed solutions. A new Kannada-MNIST dataset is mainly digital images of the Kannada language, which contains 70,000 28×28 gray-scale sample images and 10 classes. It also contains a Dig-MNIST dataset, which is an out-of domain test sample dataset and a more challenging test dataset for recognition. In this paper, we evaluate the state-of-art deep learning models for Kannada-MNIST and improve their performance with data augmentation and transfer learning techniques. We manage to achieve a best accuracy of 90.27% for Dig-MNIST in the literature with Inception Model.

articleTitle: Multi-Carrier Peak-to-Average Ratio Suppression and Data Quality Assurance Algorithm Based on Multi-Filter Bank
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Due to the severe limitation of the power of load platforms such as satellites, drones, and the Internet of Things, in order to be able to use OFDM to improve spectrum utilization efficiency and access to large-scale users, how to control OFDM's high PAPR(peak-to-average ratio) has become a communication industry Research hotspots. The signal distortion technology suppression method uses a filter to suppress or truncate parts with peak ratios that are too high, resulting in an increase in the signal EVM and an increase in BER (bit error rate). This paper first builds a multi-carrier signal transmission model, and analyzes the peak-to-average ratio and the degree of signal quality distortion of the multicarrier signal. On this basis, a multi-carrier modulation method based on a multi-filter bank is designed to specifically suppress the power of each sub-carrier, and then the sub-carriers are superimposed on this basis, so that the information of each subcarrier is saved, and suppress the excessively high peak-to-average ratio after subcarrier superposition. Build a multicarrier communication environment in MATLAB and verify the performance advantages of the modulation method in this paper on PAPR and EVM.

articleTitle: Realization of Physical Unclonable Circuit IP Core on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Physical unclonable circuit (PUF) is a new type of encryption technology, which has the characteristics of unclonable, anti-tampering and unpredictable. This paper introduces the principle of arbiter PUF and proposes an adjustable arbiter PUF circuit to enhance the uniformity and reliability of PUF. Next, the process of implementing this circuit on the FPGA is shown, including how to use the look up table(lut) to implement the two logic gates, how to write the constraint file in Tcl script language, and how to manually place and route to achieve that two paths of the arbiter PUF are completely symmetrical.

articleTitle: Study on Using Scenarios of Linear and Nonlinear Classifiers
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Classifier plays a crucial role in data mining by establishing a function or model based on existing data, which can then map all the data in the database to one of a given category to help with prediction. However, as the known data have various problems, such as errors in samples and how to define categories accurately, which will have a huge impact on the accuracy and temporal cost of its results, it is very important to select the optimal classifier based on the known samples. Before selecting a classifier, a detailed understanding of the advantages and disadvantages of each classifier can produce twice the result with half the effort. In this paper, classifiers are divided into linear classifiers and non-linear classifiers, and some typical linear classifiers and nonlinear classifiers are listed, comparing their advantages and disadvantages via their classification principles. This helps to select the most appropriate classifier and improved classifier.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of D2D System Based on Android and JXTA
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This essay is about researching and designing a wireless “D2D” system which is based on JXTA protocol and mediated by Wi-Fi with the Android OS as running platform. The system mainly contains two functions (text chatting and file sharing) as well as two auxiliary module (networks configuration and device discovery). The system is able to build a wireless D2D system based on several smartphones in close range so that the users can easily do the communication and resources sharing and eventually becomes an efficient way to enrich the phones resources.

articleTitle: Application of Cloud Computing Clustering Mining Algorithm in Logistics Scheduling Information
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: To solve the problem of large amount of logistics data and difficult distribution scheduling, this paper proposes the logistics data clustering analysis based on the combination of Prime algorithm and K-means clustering algorithm based on cloud computing to classify the logistics data of cloud platform. On this basis, considering the cost of distribution, the ant colony algorithm is used to optimize the route of order distribution. Finally, the simulation results show that the algorithm used in this paper has fewer iterations and high clustering accuracy, and the load ratio is more than 80% in order distribution, which effectively reduces the cost of logistics distribution.

articleTitle: The Application of Machine Learning in Gesture Prediction on EMG Dataset
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: With the development of electric technology, mobile devices share a considerable portion of nowadays' market, and thus hl-tech enterprises have a large amount of investment in auxiliary product attached to smartphones and personal computers. For instance, bracelets are one of those commodities, in which sensing devices are settled to capture users' gestures and other activities. Therefore, large quantities of experimental statistics are required to be analyzed and classified to provide reference to Research and Development departments. However, traditional methods rely on subjective judgement and rules of thumb, leading to a lack of efficiency and accuracy. To avoid aforementioned deficiency, this article adopts several different approaches of machine learning to assure the accuracy and objectivity.

articleTitle: Research on Business District Operation Planning Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: This paper applies machine learning core algorithms to business district operation planning to explore the attributes of retail performance and operational efficiency of Business District. This paper mainly uses K-Nearest Neighbor Algorithms to sort shops by their consumption records. Besides that it also uses K-means Clustering Algorithm and Association Rules Algorithm to cluster shop consumption types and uses association rules to find consumption association routes. Based on the above operation results, it can provide more accurate and effective data for business operators to make business district operation plans.

articleTitle: A Systematic Review of Machine Learning Approaches for Mental Disorder Prediction on Social Media
publicationTitle: 2020 International Conference on Computing and Data Science (CDS)
abstract: Mental disorder is a prevalent yet overlooked illness. Social media offers a way to detect mental patients in a broad population.
